items.text: Software Engineer with 5+ years building and operating production web services, most recently in logistics and payments. Focused on backend systems: API design, relational data modelling, and keeping p95 latency predictable as traffic grows.
Comfortable owning a feature end to end — schema and API through frontend integration, deployment, and on-call — and happiest leaving systems easier to change than they were found.

bullets.label: Platform Ownership
bullets.text: Own the shipment tracking service handling 40M events per day, including schema design, API contracts, and production on-call.

bullets.label: Performance
bullets.text: Cut p95 API latency from 820ms to 190ms by adding covering indexes, replacing N+1 queries with batched loaders, and caching hot lookups in Redis.

bullets.label: Migration
bullets.text: Led the incremental extraction of billing from the monolith into a separate service, shipping behind a feature flag with zero customer-facing downtime.

bullets.label: Reliability
bullets.text: Introduced structured logging and distributed tracing, reducing median incident diagnosis time from roughly 45 minutes to under 10.

bullets.label: Mentorship
bullets.text: Mentor two junior engineers, run the team's design review rotation, and maintain the service onboarding guide.

bullets.label: Payments API
bullets.text: Built and maintained idempotent REST endpoints for card capture, refunds, and reconciliation, processing roughly $12M in monthly volume.

bullets.label: Data Integrity
bullets.text: Designed the double-entry ledger schema and reconciliation jobs that brought month-end settlement discrepancies to zero.

bullets.label: Automation
bullets.text: Replaced a manual release checklist with a GitHub Actions pipeline covering tests, migrations, and staged rollout, taking deploys from weekly to daily.

bullets.label: Compliance
bullets.text: Implemented audit logging and field-level encryption for cardholder data as part of the company's first PCI DSS assessment.

bullets.label: Client Delivery
bullets.text: Shipped features across six client web applications using React and Node.js, from discovery through launch and handover.

bullets.label: Testing
bullets.text: Raised test coverage on the shared component library from 18% to 76%, cutting regression bugs reported after release.

bullets.label: Tooling
bullets.text: Standardised project scaffolding and linting across the team, removing most setup friction for new repositories.
